clauses.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §3; this duty applies when conveying a covered work.
clauses.condition_explanation: you_convey_covered_work means the actor conveys a covered work. The waiver is limited to circumvention effected by exercising rights under the License with respect to that work; the disclaimer concerns restricting operation or modification as a means of enforcing anti-circumvention rights against users.

obligation_items.content: Waive any legal power to forbid circumvention of technological measures to the extent circumvention is effected by exercising License rights with respect to the covered work, and disclaim any intention to limit operation or modification of the work as a means of enforcing anti-circumvention rights against users.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying a covered work; the waiver is limited to circumvention effected by exercising License rights with respect to that work.

clauses.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §4; applies to conveying verbatim copies of the Program's source code as received, in any medium. Conditions attach to each copy and its recipients.
clauses.condition_explanation: Each listed atom is a condition of conveying a verbatim source copy. Section 7 notices are relevant where applicable.

obligation_items.content: Conspicuously and appropriately publish an appropriate copyright notice on each copy.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying a verbatim copy of the Program's source code as received.

obligation_items.content: Keep intact notices stating that the License and any non-permissive terms added under section 7 apply to the code.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying a verbatim copy; preserve such notices if present.

obligation_items.content: Keep intact notices of the absence of any warranty.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying a verbatim copy; preserve such notices if present.

obligation_items.content: Give each recipient a copy of the License along with the Program.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying a verbatim copy of the Program's source code as received.

clauses.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §4; permits charging any price or no price for each conveyed verbatim copy and offering support or warranty protection for a fee.
clauses.condition_explanation: convey_verbatim_copy_under_section_4 means a verbatim source copy is conveyed under §4, subject to applicable conditions.

clauses.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §5; applies to conveying a work based on the Program or modifications to produce it in source-code form. The interface notice condition has the stated exception.
clauses.condition_explanation: section_4_conditions are applicable §4 conditions. The whole-work licensing rule applies to the whole work and all its parts, regardless of packaging; it does not invalidate separately received permission to license otherwise.

obligation_items.content: Carry prominent notices stating that the work was modified and giving a relevant date.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying a work based on the Program or modifications to produce it in source-code form.

obligation_items.content: Carry prominent notices stating that the work is released under the License and any conditions added under section 7.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying a work based on the Program or modifications to produce it in source-code form.

obligation_items.content: License the entire work, as a whole, under the License to anyone who comes into possession of a copy.
obligation_items.object: entire modified work and all its parts, regardless of packaging
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying the work in source-code form; subject to any separately received permission that allows other licensing.

obligation_items.content: Display Appropriate Legal Notices in each interactive user interface.
obligation_items.object: each interactive user interface of the modified work
obligation_items.trigger: When the work has interactive user interfaces, except an interface need not display notices if the Program's interactive interfaces do not display Appropriate Legal Notices.

clauses.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §5; inclusion of a covered work in an aggregate does not cause the License to apply to other aggregate parts.
clauses.condition_explanation: The conditions describe the defined aggregate boundary: separate and independent works that are not extensions or combined into a larger program, and no restriction of users' rights beyond what the individual works permit.

clauses.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6; object-code conveyance requires machine-readable Corresponding Source under the License through one applicable alternative in §6(a)–(e).
clauses.condition_explanation: The §4 and §5 conditions apply as relevant. The source methods in §6(a)–(e) are alternatives, not cumulative requirements.

obligation_items.content: Convey the machine-readable Corresponding Source under the License by one applicable method in §6(a)–(e).
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source for the object-code covered work
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying a covered work in object-code form, in addition to applicable §4 and §5 conditions.

clauses.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6(a); one alternative for satisfying §6's Corresponding Source requirement.
clauses.condition_explanation: This is one alternative among §6(a)–(e), not an additional cumulative condition.

obligation_items.content: Accompany the object code with Corresponding Source fixed on a durable physical medium customarily used for software interchange.
obligation_items.object: object code and its Corresponding Source
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code in or embodied in a physical product using §6(a).

clauses.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6(b); one alternative for satisfying §6's Corresponding Source requirement. The offer provides either a physical source copy at no more than reasonable physical conveyance cost or no-charge network access to copy source.
clauses.condition_explanation: The written offer is for anyone possessing the object code. It must remain valid for at least three years and as long as spare parts or customer support are offered for that product model. The price cap applies to the physical-copy option.

obligation_items.content: Provide a written offer to give any possessor of the object code either a Corresponding Source copy on a customary durable physical medium for no more than reasonable physical conveyance cost, or no-charge network access to copy it.
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source for all software in the product covered by the License
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code in or embodied in a physical product using §6(b).

obligation_items.content: Keep the written offer valid for at least three years and for as long as spare parts or customer support are offered for that product model.
obligation_items.object: written source offer for the product model

clauses.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6(c); limited alternative for conveying individual object-code copies with the written offer.
clauses.condition_explanation: Conveyance must be both occasional and noncommercial, and the actor must have received the object code with an offer in accordance with §6(b).

clauses.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6(d); object-code access may be gratis or for a charge. Source may be hosted on a different server if it supports equivalent copying facilities; recipients need not be required to copy source with object code.
clauses.condition_explanation: Equivalent source access must be through the same place and in the same way, with no further charge. Clear directions are required if object code is offered from a network server. The source-availability duty applies regardless of hosting server.

obligation_items.content: Offer equivalent access to Corresponding Source through the same place and in the same way as object-code access, at no further charge.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code by offering access from a designated place.

obligation_items.content: Place clear directions next to the object code stating where to find Corresponding Source.
obligation_items.trigger: When the place to copy object code is a network server.

obligation_items.content: Ensure Corresponding Source remains available for as long as needed to satisfy the source-conveyance requirements.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code using §6(d), regardless of which server hosts the source.

clauses.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6(e); peer-to-peer alternative incorporates §6(d)'s public no-charge offering requirement.
clauses.condition_explanation: The actor must inform peers where both object code and Corresponding Source are offered to the general public at no charge under §6(d).

obligation_items.content: Inform other peers where the object code and Corresponding Source are offered to the general public at no charge under §6(d).
obligation_items.object: peer-to-peer object-code transmission and source-location information
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code using peer-to-peer transmission.

clauses.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6; exception concerning what must be included when conveying the object-code work.
clauses.condition_explanation: A separable object-code portion whose source is excluded from Corresponding Source as a System Library need not be included in conveying the object-code work.

clauses.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6; when the stated User Product transaction conditions apply, Installation Information must accompany Corresponding Source unless neither the conveyor nor any third party can install modified object code on the product.
clauses.condition_explanation: Applicability requires conveyance under §6, the specified relationship to a User Product, and transfer of possession and use in perpetuity or for a fixed term. The two alternatives are: provide Installation Information, or the stated inability of either the conveyor or any third party to install modified object code.

obligation_items.content: Accompany Corresponding Source with Installation Information sufficient to install and execute modified versions from modified Corresponding Source.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code under §6 in, with, or specifically for a User Product in a transaction transferring possession and use in perpetuity or for a fixed term, unless neither the conveyor nor any third party retains the ability to install modified object code on the product.

clauses.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6; Installation Information does not require continuing support, warranty, or updates for a work or User Product modified or installed by the recipient. Network access may be denied on the stated grounds.
clauses.condition_explanation: The no-continuing-service statement limits the Installation Information requirement. The stated access-denial grounds require that the modification itself materially and adversely affects network operation or violates network communication rules and protocols.

clauses.scope_note: AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0-or-later §6; applies to Corresponding Source conveyed and Installation Information provided under that section.
clauses.condition_explanation: The format must be publicly documented, have an implementation available publicly in source-code form, and require no special password or key for unpacking, reading, or copying.

obligation_items.content: Provide Corresponding Source and Installation Information in a publicly documented format with an implementation available to the public in source-code form, requiring no special password or key to unpack, read, or copy.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying Corresponding Source or providing Installation Information under §6.

Section 5's modified-source conditions, interface exception, and aggregate scope boundary are represented.
Section 6's object-code conditions, alternative source methods, their respective limitations, and System Library exception are represented.
User Product definition supplies context for §6 but is not independently citable or an operative grant or duty.
Installation Information definition supplies context for §6 but is not independently citable or an operative grant or duty.
Section 6's Installation Information requirement and its exception where neither the conveyor nor any third party can install modified object code are represented.
Section 6's limitation on continuing support, warranty, and updates, and its stated grounds for denying network access, are represented.
Section 6's public-documentation, public-source-implementation, and no-special-key requirements are represented.
